basics.name: Aaron Mundanilkunathil
basics.label: Computer Science Student
basics.summary: I am studying for a B.S. in Computer Science at San Jose State University and I expect to graduate in May 2027. This fall I am attending the University of Hawaii at Manoa through the National Student Exchange, where I am taking ICS 313 and ICS 314. Most of my projects sit where software meets hardware, from a humanoid robot at a hackathon to a construction robot I am building in my garage, and after graduation I want to work on robotics software professionally.
